note.en: No direct DAP comparison was found in the reviewed paper/project. Table 2 uses DA-squared, which is a different model; its relative panoramic result is not evidence of metric superiority over DAP.
note.zh: 已查原论文与官方项目未找到直接 DAP 比较。Table 2 比较的是另一模型 DA²，且属于相对全景几何，不能证明公制性能超过 DAP。

relativePanorama.metric: relative depth/point Rel, percent, lower is better
relativePanorama.baseline: DA²: Depth Anything in Any Direction
relativePanorama.scope: Author re-evaluation for relative geometry; do not compare across metric evaluation protocols or substitute DAP for DA².

metricConditions.metric: mean delta1, percent, higher is better
metricConditions.scope: Six pinhole benchmark results; conditioned inputs differ. These values are not panoramic DAP comparisons.
